description: This file defines a React component called SkillCompetencyProgress that visualizes learner's skill progress, categories, and gaps using various UI elements and data from context.

methods.name: getProficiencyColor
methods.description: Returns color classes based on proficiency level.

methods.name: getProgressColor
methods.description: Returns a background color class based on progress percentage.

methods.name: getGapIndicator
methods.description: Displays visual indicator of progress gap (upward, downward, or near target).
